card.title: Nintendo Switch No touch screen after Game cartridge replacement Repair

source.title: Nintendo Switch No touch screen after Game cartridge replacement Repair

symptoms: no touch after game card reader replacement

claims.statement: After swapping the game card board, touch can stop working: on a hackable console run Hekate touch calibration; on patched consoles try a different card reader revision (CV, DN, DM) or calibrate it on a hacked unit.

procedure: Run Hekate touch calibration if possible.
Otherwise try another cartridge reader revision.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
